reports.notes: General Notes EFI shut off the pump that transfers wastewater into the northern lagoon; however, it cannot remain off for an extended period. Bennett rerouted the wastewater to a cleanout on the west side of the lagoon to keep ﬂow ongoing. The coupon rack for the boilers is still pending delivery with no confirmed arrival date. The X-ray crew is onsite testing carbon welds subcontracted by Bennett; they will inspect 10% of each weld and provide a written report. During excavation of the sale gas line trench, Bennett accidentally hit a water line, which ﬂooded the trench, and they are currently pumping out the water.

subs.name: EFI
subs.items: EFI continues demolition of the 18-inch corrugated pipe and has begun demolishing the concrete vault between the two lagoons. Sandbagging operations are ongoing, and straps are being added to both lagoons.

subs.name: P1
subs.items: P1 continues ductwork installation in the office building, which is approximately 80% complete. They are still waiting on the water heater for the mechanic shop. The louver sheet has not yet been received; Chris stated it should arrive by tomorrow afternoon.

subs.name: Midwest
subs.items: Midwest has started installing support beams in the office building and continues working on connections at the DMT slab. They are also continuing welding of stainless piping.

subs.name: J&R
subs.items: J&R poured the concrete slab near the boiler room and plans to pour the slab at the mechanic shop tomorrow.

subs.name: Spray Foam Crew
subs.items: The spray foam crew continues applying the final white layer on Cell 2 and has completed acid washing on Cell 6. They are planning to begin foaming tomorrow.

subs.name: QDC
